about: A film page whose video plays in another site's player, in a frame: what a browser saw on https://www.shortverse.com/films/before-the-short-film (2026-11-14), reduced. The tab and its title; the Vimeo player's frame the video plays in and that frame's own title; the stream the player loaded (its signed address shortened); yt-dlp's answer for that stream (2026.10.26, -J, reduced: it knows it only by its address, `playlist`). The extension sends `sent` as the video's title (tools/extension/test.mjs); the app names the file `file` (crates/app/src/videodlg.rs).

frame.title: Before The - Short Film from Justin Barry on Vimeo
